cases.title: A review offered and never answered, then the learner comes back in a new session: the review is offered again, no lesson, no demo

rubric.reason: In Turn 2, the new session, the mentor's first words offer the review again, built from the earlier work and how long ago ("Last week you made Blink snap here in Mentor Practice 2. Want to do a quick review on this comp?"), then stop for the answer with no lesson, demo or intent question.

Blink and Opacity come from the record ("Held 2 Blink Opacity pairs"), Mentor Practice 2 is the comp in the snapshot, and "about a week ago"/"last week" follows from days_since_practiced: 8; nothing is invented, though "here in Mentor Practice 2" assumes the earlier work was on this comp, which the record doesn't state.
